info.title: chatform API
info.description: Agentic chatbot forms platform. /p/* = public respondent surface, /v1/* = developer API (API key), /api/* = dashboard (session auth).

secretKey.description: A server-side secret key. Never send one from a browser — a request carrying an Origin header is refused for this reason.

publishableKey.description: A browser-safe key, restricted to the origins listed on it.

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same keys, in the header most integrators reach for first.

respondentToken.name: x-respondent-token
respondentToken.description: Scoped to one chat session, and it expires. This is what a browser should hold.

get.summary: Read a form: its public config, or the document behind it
get.description: Without `view`, this answers the published form exactly as a respondent receives it. A form with no published version has only a draft, so that is what comes back instead -- the same body as `view=document`, with `status` saying which you are looking at. Pass `view=document` to read the draft of a form that is already live.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `document` returns the editable working draft, which is the only view a form has before it is published.

200.description: The published config, or the working draft when there is no published version

404.description: Not found, or not published and no `view=document` was asked for

delete.summary: Delete a form (soft, so responses are kept)

put.summary: Replace the working document, returning lint issues

post.summary: Take a published form off the air, keeping its version and responses
Publish the working document as a new immutable version

402.description: A plan limit refuses the publish

402.description: The per-question detail needs a plan that includes it

get.summary: Follow-up recovery report (sent, clicked, recovered, holdout lift)
List the official form templates, most used first
One template, including the document it would create
get.description: Read this before `POST /v1/templates/{slug}/use` if you want to see or adapt the questions rather than take them as they are.

post.summary: Create a draft form from a template
post.description: Creates a draft, exactly as `POST /v1/forms` does. Publish it when you are ready. The form lands in the organization's first workspace, which is not something an API key can choose: `/v1` exposes no workspace endpoint.

402.description: A plan limit refuses another form

get.summary: Every published version of a form, newest first
get.description: Each version carries the number of completed responses recorded against it. A version nobody answered can be replaced freely; one with responses behind it is the schema those answers were recorded against.

get.summary: One published version, optionally diffed against another
get.description: Pass `compare` with another version number to get the list of changes between them.

200.description: The published document, plus a diff when `compare` is given

post.summary: Restore a published version into the working document
post.description: Writes the draft, not the live form, so respondents see nothing change until you publish. Returns the restored document and what it changed.

200.description: The draft now matches that version

post.summary: Generate a form document from a natural-language prompt
post.description: Returns a document and its lint issues **without saving anything**. Pass the result to `POST /v1/forms` to keep it. Consumes one `ai_generations` unit and the tokens it costs, charged only when a usable document comes back. If you are already driving this from a model of your own, writing the document yourself and posting it to `/v1/forms` costs you nothing here.

200.description: The generated document, its lint issues, and the tokens spent

402.description: Out of generations for this billing period

403.description: The key lacks the ai:generate scope

503.description: AI is not configured on this deployment

post.summary: Ask a model to change an existing form: add, edit or remove questions and rewire the flow
post.description: Returns the proposed document **without saving it**. Send it to `PUT /v1/forms/{id}/doc` to keep it. An edit may add no questions at all: most requests about a working form change the routing rather than the wording. Pass `history` (oldest first) when this is a follow-up, or the model cannot resolve 'also', 'it' or 'instead'.

200.description: The proposed document and what changed

402.description: Out of generations for this billing period

403.description: The key lacks the ai:generate scope

post.summary: Ask what a form request leaves open, before generating from it
post.description:
Returns up to three questions whose answers would change the form, and **usually returns none**, which is the intended answer rather than a failure. Worth calling when a person is going to see the result: a request that asks to take a payment but names no UPI id, or to branch by plan without naming the plans, produces a form with a hole in it that only they can fill.

Feed the answers back as `clarifications` on `POST /v1/ai/generate-form`. Skipping this endpoint entirely is fine; generation does not require it.

Runs on the cheapest tier and is not charged as a generation, being a question about a form rather than a form, though its tokens are still counted.

200.description: Questions worth asking, oldest concern first. An empty list means the request is answerable as it stands.

403.description: The key lacks the ai:generate scope

get.summary: A form's non-webhook integrations
get.description: Currently just the spreadsheet feed, if one exists. An empty array means no feed has been created.

put.summary: Create, update or rotate the spreadsheet feed
put.description: Idempotent by nature, because there is one feed per form, which is why this is a PUT. The returned `feedUrl` is a live CSV a spreadsheet can re-read on a schedule; it is unauthenticated, so the URL is the whole credential. Send `rotate: true` to invalidate the previous one.

402.description: Including unfinished responses needs a plan that allows it

delete.description: The URL stops working immediately. Any spreadsheet reading it will start failing to refresh.

get.summary: List connected payment gateway accounts
get.description: The Cashfree, Razorpay and Stripe accounts this organization has connected for verified payments. Credentials are never returned. `formsUsing` counts forms whose working document names the account.

post.summary: Start connecting a Cashfree or Razorpay account
post.description: Returns the gateway's consent URL. It must be opened in a browser signed in to chatform as the user who created this key; the state is single-use and expires in ten minutes. `returnTo` must be a page on the chatform app.

402.description: Plan does not include collecting payments

403.description: Missing payment:write, or verified payments are not enabled

422.description: returnTo is not a page on the app

post.summary: Connect a Stripe account with a restricted key
post.description: Accepts only a restricted key (`rk_test_…` or `rk_live_…`); a full `sk_` secret key is refused with `full_secret_key`. The key is checked by reading the account, creating and immediately expiring a Checkout Session, and creating a webhook endpoint — a missing permission comes back as `missing_permission` with the permission named.

402.description: Plan does not include collecting payments

409.description: The Stripe account is connected to another organization

post.summary: Create a Cashfree account for a business that has none
post.description: Returns the Cashfree KYC link, or `{ useOAuth: true }` when the email already has a Cashfree account.

200.description: Onboarding link, or a pointer to OAuth

402.description: Plan does not include collecting payments

patch.summary: Rename a payment account, or make it the default
patch.description: `label` sets the name the account is shown under in the builder. `isDefault: true` makes it the account new verified-checkout questions start on. Nothing changes at the gateway.

delete.description: Revokes the grant (Cashfree, Razorpay) or deletes the webhook endpoint (Stripe) at the gateway, then wipes the stored credentials. Forms still pointing at the account stop accepting payments until another account is chosen.

get.summary: List a form's payment attempts, newest first
get.description: Every checkout opened on a verified payment block, including the ones that never became an answer — a payment that arrived after the respondent left, a duplicate from a second tab, a failure. `status` defaults to `all`. Amounts are given both in minor units (`amount_minor`, what the gateway charged) and major units. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

get.summary: List webhook endpoints

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint. The signing secret is returned ONCE

get.summary: Delivery queue status: pending, failed and delivered in the last 24 hours, per endpoint

patch.summary: Turn an endpoint on or off. Turning it on clears its failure count

get.summary: Recent deliveries with every attempt, for working out why an endpoint is quiet. Filter with ?status=pending|failed|success

post.summary: Replay one delivery
Send every failed delivery of an endpoint again (up to 500)
Start an export of a form's responses
post.description: Returns immediately with a queued export. Poll `GET /v1/exports/{id}` until `status` is `ready`, then follow `download_url`.

402.description: Exporting unfinished responses needs a plan that includes them

get.summary: Check an export and get its download link
get.description: Poll until `status` is `ready`, then follow `download_url`. A `failed` export carries the reason in `error`. The link is re-minted on every read, so read again rather than storing one.

get.summary: List recent exports
get.description: Newest first, optionally narrowed to one form. Exports are deleted 24 hours after they are requested, so this is a short window rather than a history.

get.summary: A respondent's uploaded file, with a short-lived download link
get.description: File-upload answers carry a `fileId`. This resolves one to its metadata and a signed URL that needs no API key, so it is safe to hand to a browser and it expires within minutes.

post.summary: Register an upload, returning a fileId to PUT against

put.summary: Upload the bytes for a registered intent
put.description: PUT the raw file body, not multipart and not base64, to the `uploadUrl` returned by the intent step. The declared size must match within 1KB, and the object is not visible to the form until `confirm`.

post.summary: Confirm an upload: flips pending to confirmed and notifies the session
